summary: Tested the two new features on the Expo web preview against the RC Test Store: (1) premium-gated AI recipe photos (badge for free, real AI photo for subscribed) and (2) the reactive Premium-active flip after a Test Store purchase. Both PASS. FREE flow: registered fresh account -> Discover mood-cozy -> choice-dinner -> choice-vegetarian -> cuisine-italian -> 3 recipe cards all render the 'AI photo · Premium' badge and NONE show the 'Plating…' AI-generation badge (screenshot /tmp/04_results_free.png). PAYWALL: Profile -> premium-card opens paywall; plan-$rc_monthly and plan-$rc_annual are both present; annual is selectable (BEST VALUE); paywall-subscribe is enabled (aria-disabled=None) — identity is bound after registration. PURCHASE: paywall-subscribe -> confirm-buy -> RC Test Store overlay -> 'Test valid purchase' completes; the Profile 'premium-card' now flips to 'Premium active / You have every feature unlocked' WITHOUT a page reload (screenshot /tmp/p5_profile_active.png). This confirms the iteration_101 regression fix (queryClient.setQueryData in purchaseMutation onSuccess in /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx lines 86-88) is working. SUBSCRIBER Discover cards: after subscribing, the previously-rendered result cards re-fetched the AI images and now show real AI food photos with NO 'AI photo · Premium' badge (count=0), confirming the RecipeCard.tsx gating (`enabled: !recipe.image_url && isSubscribed`) flips correctly. As documented in the review note, the 7-day trial label is NOT shown on web because purchases-js Test Store does not expose introPrice — NOT flagged as a bug. No regressions: Shopping / Saved / Profile tab navigation all work without red screens; no error-screen testID present. Only carryover non-blocking issues are the Expo web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' and 'props.pointerEvents') already noted in iteration_101.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking deprecation warnings still logged on every screen: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Present in shared styles / theme (makeStyles) and some Pressable/ScrollView usages. Reference: src/theme (shadow* on card styles like RecipeCard.tsx line 127-131) and any pointerEvents prop usage.

action_items: None required for the two shipped features — premium photo gating + reactive Premium-active flip both work end-to-end.
OPTIONAL polish: migrate remaining shadow* styles in theme/StyleSheet to boxShadow (Expo web) and replace pointerEvents prop usage with style.pointerEvents to silence deprecation warnings.

OPTIONAL: after a successful purchase, router.back() is called immediately — the paywall's own 'premium-active' testID therefore never gets a chance to render before the paywall pops; that's cosmetic and the Profile card correctly reflects the state without reload.
critical_code_review_comments: RecipeCard.tsx correctly gates AI image fetch behind `enabled: !recipe.image_url && isSubscribed` (line 55) and computes `showPremiumPhotoHint = !recipe.image_url && !isSubscribed` (line 57). Both badge branches are mutually exclusive: Plating shows only while subscribed AI query is loading, Premium hint shows only for free users. Correct.

revenuecat.tsx purchaseMutation now seeds the react-query cache in onSuccess with returned customerInfo (line 86-88) — this is the fix that makes Premium-active flip without page reload. Same for restoreMutation. Verified working.

paywall.tsx correctly reads hasTrial from product.introPrice and shows '7-day free trial' copy when present; on web (Test Store) introPrice is undefined so the label is (correctly) not shown — matches the agent-to-agent note.
identityBound flag correctly enables paywall-subscribe after registration (identity bound via Purchases.logIn on user id).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the two shipped features (premium photo gating verified free+subscribed; reactive premium-active flip verified on Profile without reload)

seed_data_creation: Registered two fresh accounts test+<ts>@example.com / Test1234 during the run. No cleanup needed.

Trial label not visible on web (introPrice absent in Test Store) — do not flag.
rca_of_issue: No new bug. Verified iteration_101 fix (setQueryData in purchaseMutation.onSuccess) works: after Test Store purchase, isSubscribed flips reactively via react-query cache seeding, so Profile 'premium-card' shows 'Premium active' and Discover cards no longer render the 'AI photo · Premium' badge — both without any page reload.
